lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: Movement. Center of the hall. Something large.
lines.lens: Stone construct. Three meters tall. Defensive posture — it's guarding the archway behind it. Corruption visible: dark veins through the stonework, pulsing at irregular intervals.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.monologue: He put his hand on Zi's arm without thinking. He never touches anyone without thinking.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: That's a sentinel. A real one. These were built to protect libraries, archives — places where knowledge was stored. They weren't weapons. They were caretakers.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.monologue: He can feel it. The same way he felt the threshold markers — something in his chest tightening, like standing too close to a wound.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: The corruption. It's deep. Whatever this was, it's been in pain for a long time.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.lens: No. The archway is the only passage forward. The sentinel's patrol radius covers the full width. And it's already seen us.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: Whatever it was guarding is probably still behind it. Or was.
lines.monologue: His voice is steady but his hands aren't. He's thinking about what's being lost, not what's about to happen.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: We don't have a choice. Stay tight. Watch for the arm — it's favoring the left side.
lines.lens: Left shoulder joint compromised by corruption. It'll swing wide. That's the opening.
